entry.title: Flow Matching Quickstart
entry.summary: A very short implementation focused guide about to flow matching
entry.content:
Goals: 1. Explain why flow matching is useful. 2. Explain how it works and how to implement it at the same time.

Why its useful: - can generate data from complex distributions - simpler to implement than other diffusion models like normalizing flows, diffusion models, GANs etc. - state of the art quality image generation (stable diffusion, ... [TODO: other examples]) - training and sampling is faster
